pcs.pc_description: inspect the oil and filter on the air compressor, drain the tank manifolds and all water traps according to the manufacturer's instructions
check the oil level in all gear boxes, hydraulic unit, drum motor oil and auto-roll as per the procedures set by the manufacturer
ensure that the cement bin aeration system is in good working order
ensure that all bins and silos are full as per the production requirement
check the tension on all v-drive and other belts for wear and strain
ensure that liquid admixtures are stored as per the organizational standards to avoid contamination
ensure that the admixture dispensers are in proper working order
ensure that safety equipment is present and securely mounted as per the organizational standards
inspect the electric drive motors for wire damage and loose electrical fittings
before cleaning or chipping a mixer, make sure the motor is turned off
ensure weigh hoppers are emptied from the previous day's operation
examine the area under the plant for spillage and the source
ensure visual inspections are carried out for broken load cells, leaks, dust build-up in bag house, worn gates,
examine conveyors, boom scrapers and skip bucket for free running and wear and make adjustments as needed
ensure that all hoppers and doors are clean and in good working order
examine the central mixer blades, strippers, or arms for wear and tightness and and adjust as necessary
examine the tightness of all hydraulic connections as well as the condition of flexible tubing
check and remove any cement or concrete build up in the mixer
examine the dust seals on cement hoppers for wear
make certain that all bearings and gears are adequately lubricated
look for structural cracks or damage in the mixing drum
all bolts and bearing set screws should be inspected and tightened
keep the generator running and keep the voltage and frequency at acceptable levels
check and confirm that all cabin controls, including electronic displays, sensors are in good working order
ensure that before work, the machine should have an empty running
maintain a inspection/maintenance logbook to record all activities performed before starting the batching plant
if a fault is found that is outside of the scope of the position, notify the operator immediately

pcs.pc_description: plan and arrange the work in accordance with organisational norms
start genset and activate cross-over switch
check panel to ensure that controls are in correct position for starting
switch on the power to the control panel in accordance with the operational manual
enter and adjust values in computer system as per the mix design
start components in correct order through computer controls
ensure the production process and product complies with the appropriate quality procedures

clean the rubber chute that discharges the cement into the mixer
when working near the facility, use dust masks
make positive eye contact with other equipment operators at the site before crossing in front of or behind the equipment
wear all personal protective equipment (PPE) when sampling concrete and during all activities
record input and output flow in accordance with the organization's preferred formats
